Plot Spatial Distribution of Removed QC Spots

Source: R/qc_runner.R
plot_qc_removed_spots.Rd

Visualises the spatial locations of spots retained and removed after quality control filtering. Retained spots are shown in blue, while removed spots are shown in red.

Usage

plot_qc_removed_spots(
  spe,
  spe_filtered,
  point_size = 0.8,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

Arguments

spe

Original SpatialExperiment object before QC filtering.

spe_filtered

SpatialExperiment object after QC filtering.

point_size

Numeric. Size of the plotted spots. Default is 0.8.

theme_name

Character. Plot theme supported by `.get_plot_theme()`. Default is "classic".

Value

A ggplot object showing the spatial distribution of retained and removed spots.

Details

Spots are classified by comparing their column names in the original and filtered SpatialExperiment objects. All spatial coordinates are obtained from the original object.

This function helps identify whether QC filtering removes spots from particular spatial regions.

Examples

data(spe_example)

spe_qc <- add_qcs(
  spe_example,
  assay_name = "counts",
  mito_pattern = "^MT-"
)

p_cutoffs <- plot_qc_cutoffs(
  spe_qc,
  library_cutoff = 3.5,
  gene_cutoff = 0.2,
  n_points = 200,
  theme_name = "classic"
)

p_cutoffs$plot
